acceptance_criteria.condition: The Skill explicitly applies its risk, cleanup, evidence, and verification policy to this package.
The evidence gate requires evidence for source, infrastructure, and extensionless-script additions and deletions without blocking documentation fixtures.
The package has an active workflow that validates behavior-change evidence, stored evidence, tests, and patch formatting.

invariants: SKILL.md remains the single normative policy source.
The root scripts directory remains the package's canonical validator implementation.
Target repositories use copied .adam/scripts validators because the reusable workflow template expects that layout.
replaced_paths: README risk-level table duplicated from SKILL.md
README completion-gate list duplicated from SKILL.md
Generic evidence-artifact update wording that allowed unrelated changes to reuse old artifacts

safeguards.name: self-enforced evidence mode
safeguards.rationale: This repository now stores a unique evidence artifact for the maintenance change.

safeguards.name: active CI quality gate
safeguards.rationale: The repository workflow runs evidence validation, tests, and diff formatting checks on pull requests and main pushes.

safeguards.name: deleted script detection
safeguards.rationale: The gate reads the base Git blob when an extensionless shebang script has been deleted.

verification.result: Both GitHub Actions workflow files parsed as YAML.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert this commit to remove the self-application policy, evidence artifact, and active workflow together; the reusable target-repository workflow template remains backward compatible.

independent_review.notes: Reviewed policy, documentation, CI, tests, and the deleted extensionless-script fix after remediation.

remaining_risks: GitHub branch protection must be configured separately to prevent direct main-branch pushes from bypassing required checks.
The evidence artifact records verification facts but cannot independently prove their truth without the underlying CI logs.
